profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII), a government-backed scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council, develops the Falcon series of open-source large language models. According to its website, TII describes Falcon as "a generative large language model (LLM) that helps advance applications and use cases to future-proof our world," designed to make advanced AI accessible globally with emphasis on Middle East data residency and Apache 2.0 licensing.

The Falcon product family includes multiple models across different scales and capabilities. Falcon 180B, with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, ranks at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models. Falcon 2 11B is described as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities, and according to the site "outperforms Meta's LLaMA 3 8B" and "performs on par with leading Google Gemma 7B Model, as independently verified by Hugging Face Leaderboard." The institute also offers Falcon Arabic for Arabic-speaking regions, Falcon Perception for multimodal image understanding, Falcon-H1 combining Transformer and Mamba architecture, and Falcon Mamba 7B as "the first open source released State Space Language Model." TII established the non-profit Falcon Foundation to advance open-source generative AI development and build sustainable ecosystems around these projects.
